- ratchet 프리셋 id: `src/presets-source.js:169`에서 `` `fix-${createHash('sha1').update(ko).digest('hex').slice(0, 6)}` `` 로 파생. 항목 필드는 `id`, `ko`, `en`. 문구를 바꿔도 id는 유지된다.

- 호출자: `preparePresetRatchet`의 호출 지점(route-scan `--hook` 포함)은 grep으로 확인하지 않았다.

Inventory of worktree `<scratchpad>/wt/119`, as facts only. Several things that look like they should exist do not (see the notes after item 1 and under 3).

**1. `presets/` (one level)**
- `presets/ratchet-rules.json` (6686 B): mistake-rule presets, ko and en text per rule.
- `presets/model-rules.json` (4882 B): tier-delegation presets.
- `presets/cohesion/cohesion-en.md`: English sentence-cohesion guidance.
- `presets/delegation/bounds.md`: delegation bounds. docs/COMMANDS.md:76 says it is always injected when present.
- `presets/doc2md/convert.py`: document converter.
- `presets/korean-style/`: `fluent-korean.md`, `supplement.md`, `LICENSE-fluent-korean`. This worktree has no `rules.md` yet, only the old fluent-korean and supplement files.
- There is no `presets/agents/` directory.
- Ratchet format (`ratchet-rules.json`): `{ note: [...], rules: [{ ko, en, agents? }] }`. The id is derived, not stored. `src/seed-rules.js:93` computes `fix-` plus the first 6 hex of `sha1(r.ko)`, so `fix-bd7836` is the hash of the Korean text. Hashing the ko text keeps a user's "no" valid when the English wording changes (comment at lines 90-92). An optional `agents` array limits a preset to claude or codex (`seed-rules.js:86-88`). Loader: `presetRuleEntries()` at `src/harness.js:443`.
- Excerpt: `{"ko":"웹 fetch/search에서 robots·UA 차단(...)이 발생하면 → curl에 브라우저 UA ...","en":"When a web fetch/search is blocked by robots or user-agent checks ... → retry with curl carrying a browser UA header ..."}`.
- Model format (`model-rules.json`): `{ note, presets: [{ id:"run-t2", tier:"T2", category:"run", label, labelEn, agent:"haiku-runner", example, exampleEn, budget:{calls:8,out:1500} }] }`.

**2. `src/preset-ratchet.js` (133 lines)**
- `preparePresetRatchet()` (lines 128-133) does three things:
  - `migrateLegacyPresetRules` (82-108) moves bundled-rule lines out of `~/.claude/ratchet.md`, backs up to `.bak-preset-migration`, and marks them accepted/global/migrated in seed-state.
  - `syncPresetRatchet` (68-73) rewrites the whole file via `renderPresetRatchet` (`src/harness-templates.js:69`).
  - `ensurePresetImport` (115-125) adds the `@` import line inside the marked harness block of `~/.claude/CLAUDE.md`, and skips if the block is absent.
- Output paths (35-39): `~/.claude/ratchet-preset.md` for Claude, `<CODEX_HOME>/ratchet-preset.md` for Codex. The file is written only if its content changed (`writeIfChanged`, 45-53).
- Which presets apply (56-61): `ratchetPresets(lang, {agent})` filtered to `decided[id].action==='accepted' && scope==='global'`. Project-scope acceptances go to that project's `ratchet.md` instead (comment, lines 16-17). A preset removed in a later release simply stops rendering, and its answer stays in seed-state (63-67).
- Skip storage: `sprag seed skip <id>` calls `skipSeed` (`src/seed-rules.js:247-260`), which calls `recordDecision(id,'skipped',...)`. If the preset was already accepted globally, it records `{was:'accepted'}` and re-syncs the file, so the rule disappears.
  - State file: `<userDataDir>/seed-state.json`, or `codex-seed-state.json` for Codex (`seed-rules.js:52-54`).
  - Shape: `{decided:{"<id>":{action:'accepted'|'skipped',at,scope?,targetRoot?}}}`. `seed reset` empties it (263-269).
- Callers:
  - `src/commands/route-scan.js:305`, in the hook path.
  - `src/commands/install.js:387-388` and `:478` (Codex).
  - `src/commands/codex.js:425-426`.
  - `src/codex/hooks.js:184`.

**3. Delegation agents and `ratchet-model.md` rendering**
- Agent definitions are in code, not in markdown files: the `DEFINITIONS` array at `src/delegation-agents.js:33-82`.
  - Agents: haiku-explore (haiku, low), haiku-runner (haiku, low), haiku-translate (haiku, low), sonnet-worker (sonnet, medium), opus-worker (`claude-opus-5-5`, high).
  - `render(def)` is at lines 82-98.
- Installed to `<claudeUserDir>/agents/<name>.md` (line 100) by `syncDelegationAgents()` (125-147). It skips files that are unreadable or not owned. Removal is `removeDelegationAgents()` (113).
- Version marker: there is none. Ownership is a marker line `# managed by sprag (sprag:delegation-agent); edits are overwritten` (`OWNER_MARK` at line 20, `MARK_LINE` at 21). `isOwned` checks that string in the frontmatter. `delegationAgentStatus()` (149) reports absent, installed-by-sprag, or user-file.
- Sync is called from route-scan.js:299, before `mrHook.syncAllFiles()` at :300.
- Rule templates are in `src/model-rules.js`:
  - `modelRuleBaseText` is at 144-160. The Korean templates are at 147, 150 and 151. The English ones are at 155, 158 and 159. Tiers are T2 ("Simple/단순 요청"), T1 ("Moderate/중간 난도 요청") and T1H ("Heavy/고난도 구현", Fable and Mythos sessions only).
  - `composeRuleText` (104-114) appends `(상한 <cap>)` or `(cap <cap>)` via `budgetCapPhrase`.
  - Agent phrases come from `agentPhrase`, `agentPhraseEn` and `t1Target` in the same file.
- Note: the `~/.claude/agents/t2-*` and `t1-worker` names in the user's ratchet-model.md are not in this worktree's DEFINITIONS. This worktree still uses haiku-*, sonnet-worker and opus-worker.

**4. Server-side distribution and the update check**
- Presets and agents are never downloaded. Both are read from the installed package: `presets/*.json` via `readFileSync` (`seed-rules.js:72`, `harness.js:448`), and agent definitions from the `DEFINITIONS` constant.
- Every `fetch(` in src:
  - `src/update-check.js:354`: the GitHub releases API.
  - `src/update-check.js:379`: the npm registry.
  - `src/team-sync.js:126` and `:160`: Supabase.
- Team layer: `rpc()` (`team-sync.js:120`) POSTs to `${url}/rest/v1/rpc/<fn>`. `team_rules_get` (called at :459, in the sync after `ledger_upsert`) returns approved team ratchet rules. It runs only after `team join` or with `SPRAG_TEAM_TOKEN`. This is the only server-delivered rule text today.
- Update check (`src/update-check.js`):
  - URL: `https://registry.npmjs.org/sprag-cli/latest` (line 379, 5 s timeout, `FETCH_TIMEOUT_MS` at 60).
  - Release highlights come from `https://api.github.com/repos/rootstudioyaml/sprag/releases/tags/<ver>` (`RELEASES_API`, line 205), fetched only when a newer version exists.
  - Cadence: 24 h default (line 53). Statusline reads the cache and spawns a detached `update-check --refresh --quiet` child (~lines 170-195). SessionStart uses a 3 h interval (`SESSION_START_CHECK_INTERVAL_MS`, line 59).
  - Cache: `<userDataDir>/update-check.json`.
  - Disable: `SPRAG_NO_UPDATE_CHECK=1` or any `NO_UPDATE_NOTIFIER` (`updateCheckDisabled`, lines 66-68).

**5. "Nothing leaves your machine" statements** (no exact phrase match; closest wording)
- docs/INSTALL.md:83 ("Everything Sprag measures comes from files on your machine. The list below is every place it talks to over the network") plus the table at :85-95.
- docs/INSTALL.md:97: "No usage data, transcript content or project paths leave the machine, unless you join a team."
- README.md:309 and README.ko.md:255: "Sprag stays local unless you opt in."
- docs/TEAM.md:5: "Sprag is local-only by default." docs/TEAM.md:159: "Rule text leaves your machine only through `sprag team propose`." docs/TEAM.ko.md:5 has the Korean version.
- docs/GATEWAYS.md:72: "Does it call an LLM or need an API key? No. Everything is post-hoc analysis of the session logs ... on your machine."
- docs/CODEX.md:178 has a related "No network" line.
- Any new download of presets or agents would need a new row in the INSTALL.md network table and a change to that INSTALL.md:97 sentence.

- `presets/model-rules.json` (4882 B): tier-delegation seeds. Shape is `{note, presets:[{id:"run-t2", tier, category, label, labelEn, agent:"haiku-runner", example, exampleEn, budget:{calls:8,out:1500}}]}`. Example ids are `run-t2` and `run-t1` (budget calls:null, out:6000). The `explore-t2` entry follows the same shape. Rule sentences are composed at accept time from `modelRuleBaseText()`.
- `presets/korean-style/`: `fluent-korean.md`, `supplement.md` and `LICENSE-fluent-korean`. These are the older Korean style files, not the `rules.md` that CLAUDE.md describes.
- `presets/cohesion/cohesion-en.md`: loaded by src/cohesion.js:26.
- `presets/delegation/bounds.md`: loaded by src/delegation-guard.js:33. It holds the four bounds injected into spawned subagents.
- `presets/doc2md/convert.py`: the document converter.
- There is no `presets/agents/` directory. package.json:28 ships `presets/`.
- Id derivation: `fix-` plus the first 6 hex characters of SHA-1 of the Korean text, `createHash('sha1').update(r.ko).digest('hex').slice(0,6)` (src/seed-rules.js:93). The id is hashed from `ko` so a reworded English copy keeps the user's earlier answer (comment at :90-92). Example: `fix-bd7836` is the web-fetch UA rule.

**2. src/preset-ratchet.js (133 lines)**
- `presetRatchetPath()` (:35-39) returns `~/.claude/ratchet-preset.md` for Claude and `<codexUserDir>/ratchet-preset.md` for Codex.
- `acceptedGlobalPresets()` (:56-61) keeps a bundled preset only if `seed-state.decided[id].action==='accepted' && scope==='global'`.
- `syncPresetRatchet()` (:68-73) regenerates the whole file through `renderPresetRatchet()` (src/harness-templates.js) and `writeIfChanged`. A preset that a newer release dropped simply stops rendering, and its answer stays in seed-state.
- `migrateLegacyPresetRules()` (:82-108) moves bundled lines out of the old global `ratchet.md` and backs up to `ratchet.md.bak-preset-migration`.
- `ensurePresetImport()` (:115-125) adds the `@~/.claude/ratchet-preset.md` import inside the marked harness block of `~/.claude/CLAUDE.md`.
- `preparePresetRatchet()` (:128-133) runs migrate, then sync, then the import.
- Skip storage: seed state lives at `userDataDir()/seed-state.json` (`codex-seed-state.json` for Codex), shaped `{decided:{"<id>":{action:'accepted'|'skipped',at,scope?}}}` (src/seed-rules.js:23, :52-54). `skipSeed()` (:247-260) records `{action:'skipped', was:'accepted'}` and then calls `syncPresetRatchet`, which removes the line from the file.
- Callers of `preparePresetRatchet`:
  - src/commands/route-scan.js:305, inside the `--hook` branch (SessionStart, begins at :276)
  - src/commands/install.js:388 and :478
  - src/commands/codex.js:426
  - src/codex/hooks.js:184
- Callers of `syncPresetRatchet`: src/seed-rules.js:188 (accept) and :258 and :269 (skip and reset).

**3. Delegation agents and ratchet-model rendering**
- src/delegation-agents.js:33-78 has `DEFINITIONS`. Each entry has model alias, effort and tools:

| Agent | Model | Effort |
|---|---|---|
| haiku-explore | `haiku` | low |
| haiku-runner | `haiku` | low |
| haiku-translate | `haiku` | low |
| sonnet-worker | `sonnet` | medium |
| opus-worker | `claude-opus-5-5` | high |

- Every definition is inline code. There are no `.md` templates in `presets/`.
- `render()` (:80-97) writes the frontmatter and body.
- Version marker: `OWNER_MARK='sprag:delegation-agent'` (:20) and `MARK_LINE` (:21). It is a YAML comment inside the frontmatter, and only files carrying it are overwritten or deleted (`isOwned` :103). There is no numeric version field.
- Install path is `~/.claude/agents/<name>.md` (:99-100), written by `syncDelegationAgents()` (:125). It is skipped for Codex and when `config.delegationAgents===false`. Callers are src/commands/route-scan.js:300, src/commands/install.js:376 and src/commands/delegate.js:162.
- src/agents.js:25-29 is the `AGENT_MODEL` map. :55 is `TIER_AGENT = {sonnet:'sonnet-worker', opus:'opus-worker', haiku:'haiku-explore'}`.

Inventory of wt/119 (HEAD 77734d8). This worktree is older than the live install: it has `presets/korean-style/fluent-korean.md` and `supplement.md` instead of `rules.md`, and the agents are named haiku-*/sonnet-worker/opus-worker, not t1-worker/t2-explore. Every path below is relative to the worktree.

**1. presets/ (one level)**
- `ratchet-rules.json` holds the text ratchet presets. Its shape is `{note:[…], rules:[{ko, en, agents?}]}` with 8 rules, two of which carry `agents` (lines 36 and 47). Example: `{"ko":"웹 fetch/search에서 robots·UA 차단…","en":"When a web fetch/search is blocked by robots…"}`. The ids are not stored in the file. `src/seed-rules.js:93` builds them as `fix-${sha1(r.ko).hex.slice(0,6)}`, which is how ids like `fix-bd7836` arise. The note says the Korean text is hashed so the id survives English rewording. The file is loaded by `presetRuleEntries()` at `src/harness.js:443-456` and filtered by `agents` at `seed-rules.js:84-96`.
- `model-rules.json` holds the tier-delegation presets: `{note, presets:[{id, tier, category, label, labelEn, agent, example, exampleEn, budget:{calls, out}}]}`. Here the ids are explicit (`run-t2`, `run-t1`, `explore-*`, `check-*`, `paste-*`, `read-*`, 10 in all). T2 entries use agent `haiku-runner` or `haiku-explore` with budget 8 calls and 1500 out (1900 for read). T1 entries use agent `sonnet` with calls null and out 6000 or 8000. It is loaded at `seed-rules.js:70-76`.
- `korean-style/` contains the vendored fluent-korean.md (MIT, with its LICENSE file) and supplement.md.
- `cohesion/cohesion-en.md` is the English cohesion guidance.
- `delegation/bounds.md` is the "Delegation bounds" text given to spawned subagents (`src/delegation-guard.js:33`).
- `doc2md/convert.py` is the Python converter run as a child by `src/doc2md.cjs`.
- There is no `presets/agents/` directory.

**2. src/preset-ratchet.js**
- The output path is set at `:35-39`: `~/.claude/ratchet-preset.md`, or `<CODEX_HOME>/ratchet-preset.md` for Codex.
- `acceptedGlobalPresets()` at `:56-61` selects the presets whose seed-state entry is `action==='accepted' && scope==='global'`, kept in bundled order and worded in this version's language.
- `syncPresetRatchet()` at `:68-73` re-renders the file from those presets via `renderPresetRatchet` (`src/harness-templates.js:69`) and writes only if the content changed (`:45-53`).
- `migrateLegacyPresetRules()` at `:82-108` moves lines in the global ratchet.md whose undated text matches a bundled rule in either language. Before doing so it writes a `.bak-preset-migration` backup, and it records each moved preset as `{accepted, scope:'global', migrated:true}`.
- `ensurePresetImport()` at `:115-125` adds the `@` import inside the harness block of `~/.claude/CLAUDE.md`, and only if that block exists.
- `preparePresetRatchet()` at `:128-133` runs migrate, then sync, then import (no import step for Codex).
- Seed state lives at `<userDataDir>/seed-state.json`, or `codex-seed-state.json` for Codex (`seed-rules.js:52-54`). On macOS userDataDir is `~/Library/Application Support/claude-token-saver` (`src/paths.js:22-30`). The format is `{decided:{"<id>":{action:'accepted'|'skipped', at, scope?, targetRoot?, was?}}}` (`seed-rules.js:23` and `:163-167`).
- `sprag seed skip <id>` is handled by `skipSeed()` at `seed-rules.js:247-260`. A pending id is recorded as `skipped`. An id already accepted globally is recorded as `skipped` with `was:'accepted'`, after which `syncPresetRatchet()` runs. `skip all` expands to every pending id (`src/commands/seed.js:46`).

  - `src/commands/route-scan.js:305`, in the `--hook` (SessionStart) path at `:273` onward. It runs after `syncDelegationAgents()` (`:300`) and `syncAllFiles()` (`:301`).

  - `src/commands/codex.js:425-426`.
